Okay, so I was thinking about how we're stuck on what to do with the clues uncovered from the Odd Allies story page, and I began to wonder if the name itself might be a clue somehow.

 

Odd as in odd numbers?  I took all the even numbers out of the BGG object ids we've uncovered, but I'm not even sure this is the right train of thought...

 

Ambuscade: 126951 = 1951

Unity: 124185 = 115

Eternal Haka: 134393 = 13393

 

At first I thought of putting Unity's and Haka's together, since they're "allies" and it's the "odd" numbers, unfortunately that only gives an 8 digit number, 11513393, or 1339115.  Ambuscade and Eternal Haka were given as clues in the same page, and they would definitely be "odd allies" if they needed to work together, and it would make a 9 digit number, but nothing happened when I tried.  Neither /195113393, nor /133931951 worked.  In any case, I hope sharing this new perspective shakes something loose with someone else, because I gotta get some sleep.
